q8.label: 8-bit model · text encoder on the GPU

q8_low_vram.label: 8-bit model · loaded one part at a time

sources.locked: ai-toolkit ui/src/app/jobs/new/options.tsx (krea2); extensions_built_in/diffusion_models/krea2/krea2.py, which reads raw.safetensors from krea/Krea-2-Raw, the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct text encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE. Latents are cached: without it the Qwen-Image VAE encodes every step, a 5 GB peak on top of training (measured, below)
sources.divisibility: krea2.py get_bucket_divisibility: 8 for the VAE x 2 for the patch size
sources.defaults: ai-toolkit UI defaults for krea2 (timestep linear); 768 left out of the buckets because Krea 2 trained at 256, 512 and 1024 and 768 runs were reported to misbehave (community reports, ai-toolkit Discord)
sources.preview.raw: krea/Krea-2-Raw model card: 52 steps at guidance 3.5, 1024 x 1024; previews use 30 steps (community Raw LoRA pages use about 40) to keep a preview round short. The card says Raw is a base for training, not for inference: LoRAs trained on it are meant to run on Krea 2 Turbo
sources.subject: heuristic, as for Z-Image Turbo: ai-toolkit's own caption dropout default is 0.0; content_or_style per jobs/process/BaseSDTrainProcess.py
sources.effort: community report (a Krea-2-Raw LoRA on Hugging Face): 3000 steps, adamw8bit at lr 1e-4, rank 32, 19 pictures at 1024, likeness holding from about step 2000; no source gives a steps-per-picture rule
sources.hardware_profiles: measured on an RTX 5090 (32 GB) with ai-toolkit 0.12.26: PixlStash's probe (6 updates at 1024, rank 32, batch 1, one save and a round of 1024 previews at 30 steps), latents cached, the trainer's process tree read every 0.2 s through NVML and its resident memory. Each vram_mb and ram_mb is the highest peak outside previews x1.1, as a measurement on the owner's machine is admitted (training/measurements.py NEED_MARGIN); about 3.5 s per update in every 8-bit profile
sources.hardware_profiles.*.preview_peaks: measured, previews at 1024 and 30 steps, about 59 s a picture: q8 27.9 GB, q8_cached 24.2 GB, q8_low_vram 15.7 GB, q8_offload 10.3 GB. The probe on the owner's machine admits previews apart and defers them when they do not fit
sources.hardware_profiles.q8_offload: measured at 60% of the transformer's layers in RAM: 30% saved only 0.6 GB over q8_low_vram, 60% saves 3.9 GB at the same speed
sources.hardware_profiles.bf16_cached.vram_mb: derived: ran out of memory loading on the 32 GB card at 29.9 GB, before training; the 25 GB bf16 transformer with VAE, LoRA state and activations needs a larger card
sources.hardware_profiles.*.max_rank, max_batch: the rank and batch size the figures were measured at
sources.hardware_profiles.*.ram_mb: measured: the 25 GB bf16 transformer is read into RAM and quantised there, the text encoder beside it; caching captions parks the text encoder in RAM
